title: Synthesis, Characterization, DNA Binding, Biological Evaluation, and Molecular Docking Approaches of Ternary Copper(II) Complexes Involving Ciprofloxacin With Glycine and Phenylalanine.
authors: Abdel-Gawad, Menna A; Rashidi, Fatma B; Elhakim, Heba K A; Shoukry, Azza A
one_liner_zh: 该文研究铜(II)-环丙沙星-氨基酸三元配合物与CT-DNA的结合及分子对接，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作和对接方法，但对象为小分子金属配合物而非TF-DNA体系，且方法以实验为主、对接为辅，深度有限。
abstract: Metal-based fluoroquinolone complexes are known as metalloantibiotics. Nowadays, these complexes represent a novel pathway to display a promising strategy to overcome antimicrobial resistance. Numerous studies have shown that metalloantibiotics can improve antimicrobial activity against antimicrobial resistance (AMR) compared to pure fluoroquinolones. With the purpose to evaluate the bio transformation and the mechanism of binding and the biological impact of metal-based antibiotics known to have high potency and low toxicity, in the present work two novel copper(II) complexes of fluoroquinolone antibiotic ciprofloxacin with two different amino acids with the formula [Cu (Cip)(Gly)Cl].2H(2)O (1) and [Cu (Cip)(Phe)Cl].2H(2)O (2), where Cip, Gly, and Phe are ciprofloxacin, glycine, and phenylalanine, respectively. The synthesized complexes have been characterized using elemental analysis, mass, and FTIR spectroscopy. The binding properties of the complexes (1) and (2) with calf thymus DNA (CT-DNA) and bovine serum albumin (BSA) were analyzed by UV-vis spectroscopy, and the calculated binding constants (K(b)) for complexes (1) and (2) show a strong binding to CT-DNA (K(b) value for complex (1) was 5.98 x 10(3) M(-1) and for complex (2) was 1.5 x 10(4 )M(-1) less strong binding affinity was reported for binding to BSA (K(b) value for complex (1) was 1.98 x 10(3 )M(-1) and for complex (2) was 8.3 x 10(3 )M(-1)). Thermal denaturation, gel electrophoresis, and viscosity measurements were performed to assess the binding interactions of complexes (1) and (2) with CT-DNA. The results indicate that both complexes exhibit an intercalative binding mode with CT-DNA. In addition, their antimicrobial, antitumor, antioxidant, cell cycle distribution (via flow cytometry), apoptosis, and antiviral activities were evaluated in vitro.
abstract_zh: 金属基氟喹诺酮配合物被称为金属抗生素。如今，这些配合物代表了一种新途径，展示出克服抗菌药物耐药性的有前景策略。大量研究表明，与纯氟喹诺酮相比，金属抗生素能提高对抗菌药物耐药性（AMR）的抗菌活性。为了评估已知具有高效力和低毒性的金属基抗生素的生物转化、结合机制及生物学影响，本研究合成了两种新型铜(II)配合物，其由氟喹诺酮抗生素环丙沙星与两种不同氨基酸组成，分子式分别为[Cu (Cip)(Gly)Cl]·2H₂O (1) 和 [Cu (Cip)(Phe)Cl]·2H₂O (2)，其中Cip、Gly和Phe分别代表环丙沙星、甘氨酸和苯丙氨酸。合成的配合物通过元素分析、质谱和傅里叶变换红外光谱（FTIR）进行了表征。配合物(1)和(2)与小牛胸腺DNA（CT-DNA）及牛血清白蛋白（BSA）的结合性质通过紫外-可见光谱分析，计算得到的结合常数（K(b)）显示，配合物(1)和(2)与CT-DNA有强结合（配合物(1)的K(b)值为5.98 x 10³ M⁻¹，配合物(2)的K(b)值为1.5 x 10⁴ M⁻¹），而与BSA的结合亲和力较弱（配合物(1)的K(b)值为1.98 x 10³ M⁻¹，配合物(2)的K(b)值为8.3 x 10³ M⁻¹）。通过热变性、凝胶电泳和粘度测量评估了配合物(1)和(2)与CT-DNA的结合相互作用。结果表明，两种配合物均以嵌入模式与CT-DNA结合。此外，还评估了它们的抗菌、抗肿瘤、抗氧化、细胞周期分布（通过流式细胞术）、凋亡及抗病毒活性。
